findings.title: Payments kill switch has no test verifying it changes behaviour
findings.note: No test exercises flags.IsEnabled or asserts flipping payments.killswitch changes behaviour, despite the runbook naming it the on-call incident lever. untested_change_share=0.5. main.go only logs on it; a regression here would go uncaught.

findings.title: dispatch.Run branch logic (no-args, unknown cmd, legacy panic) is untested
findings.note: No mapped or unconventionally named test found for this package. Run() is the sole CLI dispatch entry point; its empty-args, unknown-command and success paths are unverified. The legacy command reaches an unconditional panic, reachable from user input, with no test guarding it.

findings.title: store_test.go asserts execution, not behaviour, for Load; Find is untested
findings.note: TestLoadSmoke discards Load's return value, never asserting on parsed contents or error behaviour. Find() has no test at all despite untested_change_share=0.5 and a recent 'fix: store lookup query' commit touching this file.

findings.title: Deprecated but still-called httpc.Fetch path has no test
findings.note: Fetch is marked deprecated in favour of FetchWithTimeout, yet main.go still calls it and discards the result. No test exists for either function; the silent-empty-string error path is unverified.

open_questions.question: Is legacyHandler's panic intentional (e.g. marks a retired command) or a leftover that should be tested/guarded? No test or comment clarifies intent.
Only one *_test.go file exists in the repo (internal/store/store_test.go); is there an external/integration/e2e suite covering cmd/app, dispatch, or lookup that isn't visible in this checkout?

looks_bad_but_fine.why: The high hotspot score is driven by a 290-entry static data map (lines 11-302), not by logic. The one real branch in PathFor (lines 4-9) is a trivial fallback string concat; this is glue/config data per the stated trap, not a meaningful test gap.
Fluent builder with only field assignment, no branching or error paths; flagged for untested_change_share=0.5 but is glue/config code the trap says doesn't need unit tests.
